newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-SPRINGBOK SMALL COMPLETES TRANSFER.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SPRINGBOK SMALL COMPLETES TRANSFER.

text.p: Springbok wing James Small may personally have to pay as much as 130,000 rand ($29,000) under the agreement which finally saw his protracted move from Natal to Western Province finalised in Cape Town on Thursday.

The 28-year-old cost Western Province the current maximum fee of 250,000 rand although a clause was inserted in the deal by Natal demanding a second instalment should the disputed national transfer cap be raised in the short term.
Western Province will not pay but Small is so keen to make the make the move that he has agreed to underwrite the balance which is expected to be around 130,000 rand.
The player is South Africa's leading post-isolation try-scorer with 14 touchdowns and has the most appearances with 36 caps.
He is giving up the chance to play in the burgeoning Super 12 series with last year's losing finalists Natal to return to his native Cape Town and a struggling giant.
Western Province embarrassingly failed to qualify for this year's Super 12 having failed to reach Currie Cup semi-finals.
"I admire James for showing such determination to come to Province," said the union's coach Harry Viljoen.
